title: Flat base change of an arbitrary quasi-compact scheme-theoretic image
statement: Let $g:T\to Y$ be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-pc-scheme], let $q:Y'\to Y$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and let $Z\hookrightarrow Y$ be the scheme-theoretic image of $g$ [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image]. Then the scheme-theoretic image of $g':T\times_Y Y'\to Y'$ is $Z\times_Y Y'$ as a closed subscheme of $Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Equivalently, its defining ideal is the extended ideal $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal O_{Y'}$. No quasi-separatedness assumption is required.
